MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The weatherproof Gorilla tape feels like a natural next choice because I have bought Gorilla tape before and could use it for repairs exposed to moisture.",
    "The epoxy fits my previous use of vinyl cement for practical repairs, while heat shrink tubing complements the electrical crimp terminals I bought by helping insulate and seal connections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Cutting wheels assume I have a metal-cutting job and a suitable tool, neither of which is established by my repair purchases.",
    "The tap kit, precisely sized washers and strong magnets need a specific matching project; being useful for DIY does not give me a reason to buy them now.",
    "Super glue fits my repair needs, but ten containers feel excessive for occasional use. The clear heat shrink kit also fits, but I would choose the black and red kit rather than buy both."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of clamps and repair supplies seem to have been taken as broad interest in metalworking equipment and specialized hardware.",
    "My past bulk purchases do not mean I want large quantities of every repair supply, especially something I would use only occasionally."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about a clear connection to a repair I can anticipate, such as protecting a wire connection or securing something against moisture.",
    "Exact dimensions, required tools and how much I would realistically use matter when I decide whether a repair item is worth buying.",
    "Two products can both suit my needs without both being purchases I would make now, as with the two heat shrink assortments."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests, but stretched them into specialized projects and quantities I have no current reason to choose."
}
